composicao: A imagem-base foi gerada sem texto. Título, chamada, moldura e assinatura editorial foram aplicados depois em HTML/CSS com as tipografias do site.
prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: social sharing preview background for an interactive literary cartographic atlas website, final crop 1200×630 (wide 1.91:1)
Primary request: create a striking original visual that makes a general audience curious to open an Atlas of Arrakis link.
Scene/backdrop: a vast ochre desert seen from a slightly elevated cinematic viewpoint at late golden hour; an immense sandworm rises diagonally from windblown dunes on the right half, its scale unmistakable but elegant rather than horrific; in the distance, dark shield-wall rock formations and a subtle dusty horizon.
Subject: the desert geography and the colossal worm. Integrate delicate archival cartographic latitude arcs, contour lines, a few abstract settlement dots and thin route marks into the sand and atmosphere as a refined editorial layer, clearly communicating ‘atlas’ without looking like a game interface.
Style/medium: premium editorial key art blending documentary desert photography with an old scientific atlas / photogravure sensibility; visually original, no resemblance to any specific film shot or production design.
Composition/framing: very wide landscape; dramatic worm and brighter sunlit dunes on the right; preserve the left 43% as darker, calmer negative space suitable for large cream title typography to be added later; strong readable silhouette at thumbnail size; no border.
Lighting/mood: high-contrast warm sunset, luminous dust, mysterious, intelligent, monumental, inviting.
Color palette: black-brown, burnt umber, ochre, muted gold, cream highlights; restrained saturation.
Materials/textures: fine paper grain, mineral sand, wind-carved rock, subtle engraved linework.
Constraints: no text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks or UI; no recognizable actors; no blue eyes; no film-specific costumes, vehicles or architecture; no gore; do not place important detail at the outer 4% safe margin. The image must work after exact center crop to 1200×630.
